minor_findings.summary: A few Unicode presentation details are normalized.
minor_findings.evidence: The original title uses em dashes and its yield and custard output use full-width ６, while the candidate uses en dashes and ASCII 6; the final Greek label also changes initial case from καραμέλα to Καραμέλα.

rationale: All multilingual ingredient facts, setup prerequisites, four operations, timings, completion criteria, and final output semantics are preserved. The differences are typographic normalization without a change in meaning.
